title: Bapt new church
author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

chapters.title: Congregatio pro Doctrina Fidei — Notificatio de Validitate Baptismatis
paras: Quaesitum est ab hac Congregatione pro Doctrina Fidei, utrum baptismus collatus apud communitatem vulgo dictam « The New Church » domini Emmanueli Swedenborg validus sit an non. Haec Congregatio, diligenti examine expleto, respondendum decrevit: Negative.
